description_en: Queries the configurations of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance that is associated with an asset. The asset is assigned a public IP address
description_zh: 查询单个公网IP资产绑定的DDoS原生防护实例的配置
name: DescribeBgpPackByIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset to query.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the asset to query.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/472620.html operation to query the IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances, Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances, and elastic IP addresses (EIPs) within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/472620.html查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP等实例的ID
parameters.name: ip
